name: 95242 · Lodi, CA
findings: ZIP 95242 (Lodi) has 91 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (52% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95242 (Lodi) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 9 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
